name: TC Table Processor
description: Table data processor for path pipelines. Read CSV/TSV/XLSX → JSON arrays → filter/sort/pivot/join → write back. Zero external deps for CSV, openpyxl optional for XLSX.
description_zh: 路径管道用表格数据处理工具。读 CSV/TSV/XLSX → JSON 数组 → 筛选/排序/透视/合并 → 写回。CSV 零外部依赖，XLSX 可选 openpyxl。

directives.usage_zh: 表格;读取,<文件路径>[,<格式>]
directives.description: Read a table file (CSV/TSV/XLSX) and return JSON array. Format auto-detected from extension.
directives.description_zh: 读取表格文件（CSV/TSV/XLSX）并返回 JSON 数组。格式从扩展名自动推断。

params_desc.file_path: File path (absolute or relative to project_root)

directives.description: Get column names, inferred types, and 3 sample rows from a table file.
directives.description_zh: 获取表格文件的列名、推断类型和前 3 行样本。

params_desc.file_path: File path to a table file

directives.description: Filter rows by condition. Query: {where: [column, operator, value], limit?}. Operators: =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, contains, starts, ends, in.
directives.description_zh: 按条件筛选行。查询：{where: [列名, 运算符, 值], limit?}。支持运算符：=、!=、>、<、>=、<=、contains、starts、ends、in。

directives.description: Sort rows by column(s). Query: {by: col_or_cols, dir: asc/desc (default asc)}.
directives.description_zh: 按列排序。查询：{by: 列名或列名数组, dir: asc/desc（默认 asc）}。

directives.description: Group and aggregate. Query: {group: col, agg: count/sum/avg/min/max, on?: col (for sum/avg/min/max)}.
directives.description_zh: 分组聚合。查询：{group: 列名, agg: count/sum/avg/min/max, on?: 列名（sum/avg/min/max 时必填）}。

directives.usage_zh: 表格;合并,<JSON数据A>,<JSON数据B>,<JSON查询>
directives.description: Join two tables. Query: {on: col, type?: inner/left/right/outer (default inner)}.
directives.description_zh: 两表合并。查询：{on: 列名, type?: inner/left/right/outer（默认 inner）}。

params_desc.json_a: JSON array of left table rows
params_desc.json_b: JSON array of right table rows

directives.usage_zh: 表格;写入,<JSON数据>,<文件路径>[,<格式>]
directives.description: Write JSON array to table file (CSV/TSV/XLSX). Format auto-detected from extension. XLSX requires openpyxl.
directives.description_zh: 将 JSON 数组写回表格文件（CSV/TSV/XLSX）。格式从扩展名自动推断。XLSX 需要 openpyxl。
